common.name: Purifier Card
common.description: Purifier card allows you to control your smart purifier.

editor.detection_help: Find readings belonging to this purifier. Existing sensor choices and custom labels are kept.
editor.detection_complete: Available readings detected. Every field is still editable.
editor.detection_none: No matching readings found. Choose sensors manually.
editor.detection_unlinked: This fan has no device link. Readings exposed by the fan are used when available; choose other sensors manually.
editor.detection_failed: Related sensors could not be loaded. You can choose them manually or try again.
editor.reading_placeholder: Automatic fan speed, or choose a sensor
editor.reading_help: Fan speed is shown by default: measured RPM when detected, otherwise the fan percentage when available. Choose a sensor to override it.
editor.advanced_preserved: Existing attribute and template settings are preserved. Choose a new sensor to replace an attribute source.
editor.shortcuts_yaml: Configure mode and speed shortcuts in the code editor. Existing shortcuts and advanced settings are preserved.
editor.valid_entity: Choose an entity such as sensor.purifier_pm2_5.
editor.code_only_note: Note: Setting actions and stats options are available exclusively using Code Editor.
